title: S.Korean tax office grants 1st refund for US covered-call ETF distributions - KED Global

 S.Korean tax office grants 1st refund for US covered-call ETF distributions
 The tax office ruling on return of capital (ROC) could pave the way for tax refunds on billions of dollars in payouts, as Korean investors challenge the treatment of US funds
 (Courtesy of Getty Images) 
 5 
 2026-11-16 15:48:41
 Regulations 
A South Korean tax office has, for the first time, accepted an investor's claim that distributions from US high-yield covered-call exchange-traded funds (ETFs) attributable to a return of capital (ROC) should be exempt from dividend income tax.
